rab 'byams rgyal ba ye shes ka dag gi/klong yangs chen po ro gcig sprul pa'i sku/ /'chi med grub dbang padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /thugs rje'i bden pa

tei:div.tei:p: )rab 'byams rgyal ba ye shes ka dag gi /klong yangs chen po ro gcig sprul pa'i sku// 'chi med grub dbang padma 'byung gnas kyi// thugs rje'i bden pa chen po bskyed du gsol// gang gi gsang ba zab mo bdud rtsi'i chos// smin grol lam bzang bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i gnad// gdams pa spyi dang bye brag ma lus pa'i// bstan pa yun ring 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// khyad par pad 'byung rig 'dzin yab sras kyi// bka' stsal gsung gi gsang ba ma lus pa// 'dzam gling gdul bya'i rgyud la brlan pa dang*// byang chub myu gu smin pa'i bkra shis shog /sgrub pa'i gnas mchog padma bkod pa'i gling*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i bsti gnas der// gtsug lag dge 'dun sde bcas rgyas pa dang*// ne pal yul phyogs kun tu dar gyur cig /zab mo gter gyi byin rlabs ma nyams pa// 'dzin dang 'chang dang klog cing chub pa'i sde// tshom bu 'bum bcas grub pa'i gnas kun tu/

/nges par dar zhing gdul bya smin gyur cig /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe ring gnas shing*/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa ma lus sel ba dang*// rig 'dzin byin rlabs 'gro ba'i rgyud 'jug pa'i// bkra shis dpal dang grags pa 'phel gyur cig /lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba yon gyi bdag /mched dang lcam dral grogs mchog ma lus pa// 'chi med srog gi ka ba nyer brtan cing*// mi mthun dgra yi dpung las rgyal byed shog /rtsa gsum ḍākki'i tshogs kyis byin brlab cing*/ /dkar phyogs gter srung dam can kun gyis kyang*// phrin las rnam bzhi g.yel med sgrub pa yi/ /nges gsang nyin mor byed pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'i shis brjod tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang chos rje gling pas spel ba'o/// /
